events.title: Golden Age of Athens
events.descr: After the Persian invasion is defeated, Athens leads the Delian League and turns it into an empire whose treasury pays for the Acropolis. Under Pericles the city is home to the playwrights Aeschylus, Sophocles and Euripides, the historians Herodotus and Thucydides, and the philosophers Socrates and Plato.
